info.title: Mako REST API
info.description:
The Mako REST API. All endpoints are prefixed with `/api`.

**Authentication.** Most endpoints accept either a session cookie (`auth_session`, set by `POST /api/auth/login`) or a workspace API key passed as `Authorization: Bearer revops_<key>`. Endpoints under `/api/connectors`, `/api/databases`, `/api/share`, and `/api/webhooks` are intentionally public.

This document is generated directly from the server's route table, so it always reflects the endpoints the API actually serves.

get.description: Returns the catalog of selectable AI models plus the recommended default.

post.summary: Log in with email and password
post.description: Authenticates a user and sets the `auth_session` cookie. The email must be verified.
Invalidates the current session and clears the cookie.

get.description: Returns the user associated with the active session cookie.

post.description: Creates a user with email + password. Returns the user and triggers an email verification code. Login requires a verified email.

get.description: Returns metadata for every available connector type. Public — no authentication required.
Lists all workspaces the authenticated user belongs to.

put.description: Replaces an app's definition. Body is validated against the shared app schema.

path.description: POSIX path relative to the project root, e.g. src/App.tsx

name.description: Binding name referenced from app code, e.g. `revenue`

connectionId.description: Workspace DatabaseConnection id to execute the query against

get.description: Lists saved consoles in the workspace.

post.description: Runs the query stored in a saved console. Supports cursor pagination via `mode`, `pageSize`, and `cursor` query parameters.

patch.description: Partially updates a dashboard. Body is validated against the shared dashboard schema.

post.description: Runs a query against a connected database in the workspace and returns the result set. Supports cursor-based pagination via `pageSize` and `cursor`.

cookieAuth.name: auth_session
cookieAuth.description: Session cookie set by `POST /api/auth/login`. Used by browser clients.

bearerAuth.description: Workspace API key. Send as `Authorization: Bearer revops_<key>`. Used by programmatic clients and agents.
